haters.quote: Heard the reservation was under someone else's name.
haters.line: A rumour is going round. Until it's dealt with, the move pays less.

haters.quote: Someone posted you mid-sneeze. It's the top comment.
haters.line: A bad photo is doing numbers.

haters.quote: Your plus-one is telling everyone they brought you.
haters.line: Nobody likes a plus-one with a narrative.

haters.quote: A burner account says you paid for your spot on the list.
haters.line: Three likes. One of them is your landlord.

haters.quote: Tiff says she did it first. She didn't.
haters.line: Basically an influencer, basically a problem.

haters.quote: Chad Kensington is pitching your night as his startup.
haters.line: He's calling it "you, but as a service".

haters.quote: Chardonnay Shade called your outfit "brave". On camera.
haters.line: Reality TV's favourite villain picked you.

haters.quote: A blind item in Lola's Blotter sounds a lot like you.
Heir Ruckus subtweeted you. His dad's lawyers liked it.
Someone showed up in your exact look. And wore it better.
Chase Clout clipped you tripping on stream. 2 million views.
haters.line: Chat, chat, CHAT is laughing at you.

haters.quote: Peyton Pastel filmed an apology video about you.
haters.line: She's sorry you made her do this.

haters.quote: Prince Nassim bought the venue and moved your night to his yacht.
haters.line: He says it's a compliment. It's not.

haters.quote: Your guest list leaked. Half of them weren't invited.
haters.line: Now they all want to be.

haters.quote: Paparazzi caught you leaving through the kitchen.
haters.line: The kitchen staff are getting interviews.

haters.quote: Lunaria unfollowed you at 3 AM. Everyone noticed by 3:01.
haters.line: Nobody knows why. That's the point.

haters.quote: Saffron Lux forgot your name. In front of everyone. Twice.
